verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe AI-generated insights inside Otter: Otter AI Chat answers questions across meetings and connected apps, drafts follow-ups and reports, and supports natural-language insight search. Otter also generates summaries with decisions, action items and role-tailored insights, auto-drafts follow-up emails, and surfaces sentiment, blockers, objections and competitor mentions. One community report of an "absurd, inaccurate" outline raises a quality concern but does not contradict the capability. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration that AI Chat and insight quality work well; detailed docs on how suggestions are generated and tuned (beyond marketing copy); evidence of proactive suggestions outside the meeting-summary context.
